author: CMDJojo
body:
I have been banned from the avicus network
Name: CMDJojo
Reason: I have flied in a nebula game
I know that I've flied in that game. That is because I tested if that worked on that server. I am so sorry for that. If I get unbanned, I will NEVER fly again on the Avicus network. I am so sorry for this. I have only flied in ONE nebula game, I promise. I am so sorry for this. I can understand you if I won't get unbanned, but I think that the Avicus network is very good and I want to play there more. If I get unbanned I will never fly more. That was like I said the first nebula game I've flied in and that was just to test if that worked on that server.

I am so so sorry for that... I think that Avicus is one of the best servers and I do not wanted to do this. I was curios to see if I could fly on that server and I will NEVER EVER do that again if I get unbanned. I can understand you if you won't unban me, but I love playing on Aicus and are so so sorry for this... I do not want this... Please unban me... Please please please...

Best regrads, CMDJojo

replies.author: Emmaye
replies.body:
Hello,

There is evident directed towards your appeal, which is shown here. Using hacked clients on public servers isn't really a smart idea to "test" with. I think you should wait a little bit longer before you can be given another chance. This appeal is denied.

Regards,
Emmaye.
